method: Fresh process per case/backend/trial. 1 first call, 5 warmups, 30 measured calls. Trial 2 reverses order. Core ML placement is anticipated, not a hardware trace. Prepare includes native compilation/loading; conversion separate. OS caches are not cleared. Native in-process latency includes input/output handling, excludes Rank/JSON IPC. Peak RSS is process lifetime high water, not model allocation. Each worker reads only its own fixture. A final untimed prediction doubles the first input and compares a recomputed float64 oracle. The same FP32 typed program is tested under CPU_ONLY, CPU_AND_GPU and ALL for Core ML; no FP16 or ANE-only result is claimed. Core ML package writing and Python startup are excluded; conversion is separate. Model outputs are materialized before stopping each prediction timer.
